poleLap.source: FastF1 car telemetry (official F1 timing API), 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Qualifying, VER pole lap; 140 samples evenly spaced by distance, top/min speed from the unresampled telemetry

trackMap.source: FastF1 position + car telemetry (official F1 timing API), 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Qualifying, VER pole lap; 260 points evenly spaced by distance, rotated 335 degrees (FastF1 circuit info)

poleDuel.source: FastF1 official sector times, 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Qualifying, best laps of P1 and P2

qualiDominance.source: FastF1 telemetry (official F1 timing API), 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Qualifying, VER and LEC fastest laps; laps aligned on official sector times; sections split at straight-line speed peaks; official corner numbers

lapsLed.source: FastF1 lap positions (official F1 timing API), 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Race, leader at the end of every lap

raceTrace.source: FastF1 lap timing (official F1 timing API), 2026 Singapore Grand Prix Race: lap-end times, positions, track status and pit-in laps of the top 8 finishers
